variables.systemTrivia: Sega Genesis is a fourth-generation home video game console developed by Sega. First released in Japan in October 1988 and discontinued in 1999. It launched at $189 in the US. About 39.8 million units were sold. It followed the Sega Master System and was succeeded by the Sega 32X. Processors include the Motorola 68000 and the Zilog Z80.
